answer: Each identity joins the meadow registry, stacking registrations into terraces of 100. Terrace band t charges 20 plus 10t credits, so terrace 9 costs 110. The band is sealed into a shale stratum any auditor can recompute from the ledger order; a forged entry is rejected and its bond burned. Joining locks a refundable 60-credit bond. A terrace-hopping ring fails: the ledger counts registrations, so spreading never reopens a cheap band. The kth fake pays its band fee plus 60 locked, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and pay 65,000 in fees, while an honest agent pays 20 and recovers its bond.
